verdict.rationale: Rive documents public, open-source runtime APIs that load and control animations, state machines and data-bound view models. A CLI lets agents generate content, and RML gives a text-based way to create and modify files. However, no documented public web/REST API for driving the editor or platform was found: all OpenAPI probes returned 404, and the MCP connection belongs to a separate story. missing for 10: documented public HTTP/REST API for the editor/platform, an OpenAPI spec, API reference depth for CLI-driven automation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.
Data binding — autoBind, view models, bindViewModelInstance
Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.
let an agent generate them with the CLI
It lets you create and modify Rive content as code, making it possible to build Rive files with coding agents and other text-based workflows instead of working exclusively in the Editor.
